name: PM-KISAN
summary: Income support for land-holding farmer families, paid directly to the bank account.
benefit: ₹6,000 a year in three ₹2,000 instalments, straight into the bank account.
steps: Register on pmkisan.gov.in or at your nearest CSC / patwari office.
Complete Aadhaar-based e-KYC and land record verification.
The state verifies the application and approves the beneficiary.
Instalments are credited to the bank account every four months.
note: Families that pay income tax, institutional landholders and government employees are excluded.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: Free hospital treatment cover for poor and vulnerable families.
benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh a year per family for hospital treatment, cashless at empanelled hospitals.
steps: Check your family on the beneficiary list at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555.
Get the Ayushman card made at a CSC, hospital help desk or the portal.
Show the card at an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

name: PMAY-Gramin
summary: Money to build a pucca house for rural families who are homeless or live in kutcha houses.
benefit: Up to ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly areas, plus 90 days of MGNREGA wages.
steps: Ask your Gram Panchayat to check your family in the SECC housing list.
Apply through the Gram Panchayat or the PMAY-G portal.
Geo-tagged photos are taken at each stage of construction.
Money is released in instalments as the house is built.

name: PMAY-Urban
summary: Help for city families to buy or build their first pucca house.
benefit: Interest subsidy of 3% to 6.5% on a home loan, or assistance under state housing schemes.

rules.label: Lives in a city or town

steps: Apply on pmay-urban.gov.in or through a bank or housing finance company.
Choose the option that fits you: interest subsidy, affordable housing or beneficiary-led construction.
Submit documents and track the application on the portal.

name: MGNREGA
full_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
summary: A legal guarantee of paid work for rural households.
benefit: At least 100 days of paid unskilled work a year per household, with wages paid to a bank or post office account.
steps: Ask your Gram Panchayat for a free job card.
Submit a written request for work and take a dated receipt.
Work must be given within 15 days, otherwise you are entitled to an unemployment allowance.
Wages must be paid within 15 days to the bank or post office account.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
summary: Free LPG gas connection for women from poor households.
benefit: Free LPG connection, first refill and stove as applicable, so cooking does not depend on firewood.
steps: Apply at your nearest LPG distributor or on the PM Ujjwala portal.
Complete KYC with Aadhaar and bank details.
The connection is issued and the subsidy is credited.

name: PM Mudra Yojana
summary: Small business loans without collateral for people starting or growing a business.
benefit: Loans up to ₹10 lakh under Shishu, Kishor and Tarun categories, with no collateral.

rules.label: Wants to start or grow a small business

steps: Approach any bank, NBFC or microfinance institution, or apply on the Udyam Mitra portal.
Fill the Mudra loan application and submit a simple business plan.
The bank sanctions the loan and the amount is credited.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: A savings account for a girl child with a high interest rate and tax benefits.
benefit: Government-backed savings account for a girl below 10, with one of the highest small-savings interest rates.
steps: Open the account at a post office or an authorised bank.
Deposit a minimum of ₹250 a year (maximum ₹1.5 lakh a year).
The account matures when the girl turns 21; part withdrawal is allowed for education after 18.
note: A parent or guardian opens the account for the girl child.

name: National Scholarship Portal
summary: One place to apply for central and state scholarships.
benefit: Tuition support and maintenance allowance for school, college and professional courses.
steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar.
Fill the application and upload documents.
Get verification done by your school or college.
Track the status on the portal until the money is credited.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: A guaranteed monthly pension after 60 for workers in the unorganised sector.
benefit: Pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month after age 60, depending on the contribution chosen.
steps: Visit your bank or post office and ask for the APY form.
Choose the pension amount you want (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
The contribution is auto-debited every month until age 60.

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, ₹3 lakh collateral-free loan at 5%, skill training and marketing support.

rules.label: Works as an artisan or craftsperson

documents: Proof of trade or family trade
steps: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or at a CSC.
Verification is done by the Gram Panchayat or urban local body.
Complete the skill training and get the toolkit grant.
Apply for the loan after training.

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
summary: Old-age pension for small and marginal farmers.
benefit: ₹3,000 a month pension after age 60, with a family pension if the farmer dies.
steps: Enrol at a CSC or on the PM-KMY portal.
Choose the monthly contribution (₹55 to ₹200, matched by the government).
Contribute until age 60 to receive the pension.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
summary: Crop insurance that pays when crops are damaged by weather, pests or disease.
benefit: Low premium crop insurance: 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial crops; the rest is paid by government.

rules.label: Grows a crop on owned or tenanted land

steps: Enrol through your bank, CSC, insurance agent or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date.
Pay the small farmer share of the premium.
If a crop is damaged, report it within 72 hours on the 14447 helpline or the app.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
summary: Very cheap accident insurance through your bank account.
benefit: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or full disability, and ₹1 lakh for partial disability, for ₹20 a year.
steps: Log in to your bank app or net banking and find the social security schemes section.
Give consent for auto-debit of ₹20 a year.
Keep the account active so the cover continues.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
summary: Low-cost life insurance linked to your bank account.
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for the family for ₹436 a year.
steps: Enable the scheme in your bank app or at the branch.
Give consent for the annual auto-debit.
Keep renewing every year before the due date.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: A zero-balance bank account with a RuPay card and accident cover.
benefit: Zero-balance account, RuPay card, ₹2 lakh accident cover and overdraft up to ₹10,000.
documents: Aadhaar card or any officially valid document
steps: Visit any bank branch or a Bank Mitra (business correspondent) point.
Fill the single-page account opening form.
Collect the passbook and RuPay card.

name: Ration card / NFSA
full_name: National Food Security Act — Priority Household ration card
summary: Subsidised or free foodgrain for poor households through a ration card.
benefit: 5 kg of free foodgrain per person per month under the extended PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana.
steps: Apply for a ration card on your state food department portal or at the tehsil office.
Verification is done by the local food inspector.
After approval, collect the card and link Aadhaar.
Collect foodgrain from the fair price shop every month.

name: Old Age Pension (NSAP)
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for people aged 60 and above living below the poverty line.
benefit: Monthly pension from ₹200 to ₹500 as the central share, plus a state top-up in most states.
steps: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, block office or your state pension portal.
Submit age and BPL documents.
After verification the pension is credited every month.

name: Widow Pension (NSAP)
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for widows aged 18 to 79 living below the poverty line.
benefit: Monthly pension as a central share plus a state top-up.
steps: Apply at the block or tehsil office with the death certificate.
Verification is done by the local official.
Pension starts after approval and is credited monthly.

name: Disability Pension (NSAP)
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for people with severe disability living below the poverty line.
benefit: Monthly pension as a central share plus a state top-up.
steps: Get a disability certificate or UDID card from the medical board.
Apply at the block office or state disability welfare portal.
Pension starts after verification.

name: Stand-Up India
summary: Bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to start a new business.
benefit: Loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for a new enterprise, plus handholding support.
steps: Apply on standupmitra.in or directly at a scheduled bank branch.
Submit the business plan and documents.
The bank sanctions the loan and provides handholding support.

name: PM SVANidhi
summary: Working capital loans for street vendors.
benefit: Loans of ₹10,000, then ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on repayment, with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback.

rules.label: Works in a city or town

documents: Vendor certificate or letter of recommendation
steps: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at a CSC.
Get a letter of recommendation from the urban local body.
The loan is credited to the bank account; repay on time to get the next higher loan.

name: Skill India (PMKVY)
summary: Free short-term skill training with a certificate and placement help.
benefit: Free training in trades like electrical work, tailoring, driving and hospitality, with certification and placement support.
steps: Register on skillindiadigital.gov.in or visit a PMKVY training centre.
Choose a course and complete enrolment.
Attend training, pass the assessment and get the certificate.
Use the placement cell for a job.

name: e-Shram
full_name: e-Shram — National Database of Unorganised Workers
summary: Free registration for unorganised workers with an ID card and accident cover.
benefit: e-Shram card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance and easier access to welfare schemes.
steps: Register at eshram.gov.in or at a CSC.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
Download the e-Shram card and keep the number safe.

name: Matru Vandana (PMMVY)
summary: Maternity benefit for the first living child.
benefit: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl.
steps: Register at the Anganwadi centre, health centre or on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Submit Form 1A within 270 days of pregnancy.
Complete the health checkups to receive the instalments.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana
full_name: Ayushman Bharat — Vay Vandana Card for citizens aged 70+
summary: Free health cover for every citizen aged 70 and above, whatever the income.
benefit: ₹5 lakh a year cashless hospital cover for senior citizens aged 70 and above.
steps: Open the Ayushman app or pmjay.gov.in and choose the Vay Vandana card.
Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar and a face scan.
Show the card at an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

name: Gruha Jyothi (Karnataka)
summary: Free electricity up to 200 units a month for Karnataka households.
benefit: Up to 200 units of free electricity every month.
steps: Apply on the Seva Sindhu portal or at a Bangalore One / Karnataka One centre.
Verify the RR number and Aadhaar.
The benefit applies from the next billing cycle.

name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
summary: ₹2,000 a month to the woman head of a Karnataka household.
benefit: ₹2,000 transferred every month to the woman head of the family.
steps: Apply on Seva Sindhu or at a Karnataka One centre.
Complete Aadhaar and ration card verification.
The amount is credited every month.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai (Tamil Nadu)
summary: ₹1,000 a month to eligible women heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
benefit: ₹1,000 every month to eligible women heads of families.
steps: Apply at an e-Sevai centre or at a special camp.
Verification of ration card and income is done by the taluk office.
The amount is credited monthly after approval.

name: Ladki Bahin (Maharashtra)
summary: ₹1,500 a month to eligible women in Maharashtra.
benefit: ₹1,500 every month to eligible women aged 21 to 65.
steps: Apply on the state portal or at an Anganwadi / Setu centre.
Submit Aadhaar, ration card and income documents.
The amount is credited monthly after verification.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar (West Bengal)
summary: Monthly income support for women in West Bengal.
benefit: ₹1,000 a month for general category women and ₹1,200 for SC/ST women.

rules.label: Has a Swasthya Sathi / ration card

steps: Apply at a Duare Sarkar camp or the block office.
Submit Aadhaar and Swasthya Sathi details.
The amount is credited monthly.

name: Kanya Sumangala (Uttar Pradesh)
summary: ₹25,000 in stages for girls in Uttar Pradesh, from birth to graduation.
benefit: ₹25,000 paid in six stages as the girl grows up and continues her education.
steps: Register on the Kanya Sumangala portal.
Complete verification at the district level.
Claim each stage payment as the girl reaches it.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman (Rajasthan)
summary: Extra income support for Rajasthan farmers on top of PM-KISAN.
benefit: ₹2,000 extra per year for eligible Rajasthan farmers, in addition to PM-KISAN.
steps: Apply through the SSO portal or an e-Mitra centre.
Complete Jan Aadhaar and land verification.
The amount is transferred annually.
